envelope.description: Drop server.unref() in the exec-stand-in test helper

body.title: Drop server.unref() in the exec-stand-in test helper
body.summary: src/workflow/__tests__/helpers/exec-stand-in.ts: keep the gh/git stand-in Unix-socket server ref'd while installed (remove server.unref()), so an awaited execFile response keeps the event loop alive; remove() still closes the server and restores PATH. Add a unit assertion that the server handle is ref'd while installed.
acceptanceChecks: installExecStandIn leaves the stand-in server ref'd until remove()
an awaited gh/git call through the stand-in resolves
remove() closes the server and restores PATH

tests.name: exec-stand-in keeps its server ref'd while installed
